name: Find and Mark!
desc:
You or your Opponent chooses a number! 🤔
⚠️ While one finds a number, the other Marks their page with X's
⚠️ Switch turns once the number has been found!
💀 Fill up your page before your Opponent or LOSE!

Be quick in finding the number as well as marking the page!!

✨Like and favorite the game to show support!
